stories.title: Democrats projected to win the House; the Senate is still being counted
stories.summary: MS NOW projected just before 10pm ET Tuesday that Democrats will win the House, and CNN, NBC News and CBS News followed. The AP had not called it at the time of Yahoo's report, and control of the Senate was still too close to call. The result shapes what happens to the CLARITY Act, the US crypto market-structure bill.
points: Seat projections differ: at least 225 House seats per CNBC and MS NOW, at least 244 per NBC, per CryptoTicker. 218 are needed for control.
Roy Cooper beat Michael Whatley in North Carolina's Senate race, per Yahoo.
Kalshi's Senate control market priced Democrats at 99.4% when read for this edition (about 04:00 UTC, 11:00 Bangkok).
The CLARITY Act passed the House 294-134 in July 2025, failed 49-50 in the Senate in September and expires on 3 January without Senate action, per CryptoTicker.
Alaska is the last state to count, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Binance hack report: a months-long North Korean campaign, not one mistake
stories.summary: Binance's incident report says attackers spent months getting inside: a tampered software install in June, a fake recruitment "coding assignment" in September, and a compromised internal AI tool in October, before draining wallets. The FBI blames North Korea's TraderTraitor group; North Korea denies it. Deposits have started to outpace withdrawals again.
points: Co-CEO Richard Teng: "This wasn't one mistake or one breach — it was a months-long campaign," per The Block.
Sources differ on the size: more than $6.3B per Binance via The Block, about $6.4B per Chainalysis. Frozen or intercepted: about $2.85B per The Block, about $2.8B per Chainalysis.
Binance says it has replenished 98% of the affected assets, per The Block.
Withdrawals hit $10.97B in the 46 hours after the hack and net outflows still stood at $5.28B, per CoinDesk citing data Teng shared; Teng says hourly deposits now exceed withdrawals.
Kim Yo Jong called the FBI announcement "a trite provocation", per AP via ABC News.

sources.label: ABC News (AP): North Korea denies involvement

stories.title: Bitcoin barely moves on election night after big fund outflows
stories.summary: Bitcoin stayed in a narrow range near $77,000 as results came in. US spot bitcoin funds lost money for a second straight day on Monday, and options prices show traders expect bigger swings around the election.
points: Benzinga had bitcoin at $77,190.21 at 8pm ET Tuesday (08:00 Wed Bangkok); CoinDesk reported a dip to about $76,300 earlier on Tuesday.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $399M on 2 Nov, and BlackRock's IBIT lost $405M, its biggest daily outflow since June, per CoinDesk.
US spot ether ETFs lost $139.7M on 2 Nov, per KuCoin citing Farside.
Near-dated bitcoin implied volatility rose to about 51% from about 43.5%, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: CFTC approves stock perps and is sued the same day
briefs.summary: The CFTC cleared single-stock perpetual futures on 3 Nov; a new trade group, the Capital Markets Alliance, sued, arguing they belong under the SEC, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy adds 811 BTC
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 811 BTC for about $65.5M between 26 Oct and 1 Nov, taking its holdings to 849,327 BTC, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: Liquid Network fully backed again after exploit
briefs.summary: The Liquid Federation says LBTC is back to 1:1 bitcoin backing after the 6 Sept exploit of about 4,000 BTC, per The Block.

briefs.title: Midterm betting tops 2024
briefs.summary: More than $1.2B has been traded on Kalshi's midterm markets, passing its 2024 presidential-year volume, per Fox News.

briefs.title: Circle reports Q3 results today
briefs.summary: Circle reports Q3 2026 results on Wed 4 Nov with a webcast at 8:00am ET (20:00 Bangkok), per the company.

briefs.title: SEC staff call Canton Coin a "digital commodity"
briefs.summary: A no-action letter says SEC staff will not recommend enforcement over Canton Coin's programmatic issuance; it reflects staff position, not a court ruling, per The Block.

briefs.title: Block: bitcoin gross profit halves after a Cash App fee cut
briefs.summary: Block reported Q3 revenue of $6.72B; bitcoin revenue fell 11% to $1.80B and bitcoin gross profit fell 50% to $52M, per its shareholder letter.

briefs.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against World Liberty
briefs.summary: Sun, who invested $45M in WLFI tokens, says the Trump-linked firm disclosed UAE ties in its ownership only months into the case and now uses them to contest jurisdiction, per CoinDesk.
